title: A joint framework for SPX, VIX and VXX
abstract: arXiv:2611.25047v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Options on VXX bring the dynamics of the VIX futures curve into the joint SPX-VIX calibration problem. We construct a common model by specifying the VIX and then recovering instantaneous SPX variance from the requirement that its risk-neutral conditional expected average over the next thirty days equals the squared VIX. With truncated signatures of time-extended polynomial diffusions, this recovery reduces to finite-dimensional linear algebra and gives explicit access to the futures underlying VXX. The same specification therefore governs equity variance and rolling volatility exposure. To accommodate flexible specifications while respecting variance nonnegativity, we develop a regularized model and quantify the pricing errors of its tractable VIX and VXX proxies. Applications to short-dated option smiles illustrate joint calibration across the three markets, with Monte Carlo estimates of the proxy error bounds well below quoted bid-ask

translated_title: SPX、VIX 与 VXX 的联合框架
translated_abstract: VXX 期权将 VIX 期货曲线的动态特性引入了 SPX 与 VIX 的联合校准问题。我们通过指定 VIX 的模型形式，并依据“未来三十天内瞬时 SPX 方差的风险中性条件期望平均值等于 VIX 平方”这一约束来恢复瞬时 SPX 方差，从而构建了一个统一的共同模型。利用时间扩展多项式扩散过程的截断签名，这一恢复过程可化为有限维线性代数问题，并显式给出 VXX 所对应的标的期货的表达。因此，同一模型设定同时刻画了股票方差与滚动波动率敞口。为了在保持方差非负性的同时容纳灵活的模型设定，我们开发了一个正则化模型，并量化了其易于处理的 VIX 和 VXX 近似代理所引起的定价误差。在短期期权微笑曲线上的应用展示了三个市场的联合校准效果，其中蒙特卡洛估计表明代理误差界限远低于市场报价的买卖价差。
tldr: 提出了一个基于时间扩展多项式扩散截断签名的统一模型，通过从指定的 VIX 模型中恢复瞬时 SPX 方差，实现了 SPX、VIX 与 VXX 三个市场的联合校准。
en_tdlr: Proposes a unified framework based on truncated signatures of time-extended polynomial diffusions that recovers instantaneous SPX variance from a specified VIX model, enabling joint calibration across the SPX, VIX and VXX markets.
